items.headline: Cabinet Decision No. 173 of 2026 introduces revised UAE eInvoicing penalties, including AED 5,000 for initial implementation non-compliance and capped continuing penalties.
The Ministry of Finance register now lists 83 fully accredited UAE eInvoicing service providers, including Zoho and Tally, with no providers shown under final assessment.
Ministerial Decision No. 197 of 2026 temporarily excludes intra-VAT-group transactions from eInvoicing and removes the UAE data-storage-location requirement, effective 1 October 2026.
Ministerial Decision No. 168 of 2026 introduces direct ASP accreditation after full assessment and testing, effective 1 October 2026.
Businesses subject to eInvoicing should select an accredited provider, contract and integrate with it, and then complete the required EmaraTax procedures.
